text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Brian. The doctor says I can't run
with you for a while.
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text:
But there are lots of other people you can
race with. So don't worry
about me—go
have fun.
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Brian... You're too fast!
text_block_list.name: Young Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run even faster next time. So
let's do another lap.
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text:
G-gimme a break! You might be having fun
'cause you're winning, but
I'm not!
text_block_list.name: Young Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... You're too fast... I... I hate you!
text_block_list.name: Young Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
U-um... Brian, do you wanna try racing
lessons? I bet there are lots of
fast runners
there.
text_block_list.name: Young Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Several years later, in racing class...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That Нарита Брайан runs very well. I heard
she hasn't been able to settle
anywhere,
though.
text_block_list.name: Racing Instructor A

text_block_list.text:
Huh, I can't imagine why. One look at her
talent and anyone would be
sorry to miss
out on having her.
text_block_list.name: Racing Instructor B

text_block_list.text: I... quit... This sucks. Why's such a fast kid here, anyway?!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
(Not again! Why don't you try harder? This
is a race! But you just...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I caaan't... Ugh, this is hopeless, no matter
how hard I try.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: I'm leaving after today.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
B-but why?! I'm sure our class was much
better than your last! Our
track is near
professional level—you can't find a higher
quality
experience elsewhere!
text_block_list.name: Racing Instructor A

text_block_list.text:
Forget it. This place isn't a challenge
anymore... It's pointless when
everyone
else has lost their drive to win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: There you are, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Come to Академия Тайсен. That's where
you'll find real racing. It may
just satisfy
that hunger of yours.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And they're off! First out of the gate is
number six!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Number eight, Нарита Брайан, is waiting for
the perfect opportunity to
break ahead!
But number six's lead keeps growing!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Haaagh!
text_block_list.name: Number Six Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Wha...
text_block_list.name: Number Six Umamusume

text_block_list.text: (Is it really happening here too?)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
No matter where I go, no matter who I
challenge, it's always the same.
I'm left
feeling hungrier than before.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I guess there's no point in staying here...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
There's no better way to collect your
thoughts than a stroll, so I go to
the
riverside for some contemplation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You're really going to do this?
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I never want to fail like that again.
That's why...
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
It's the senior student who raced against
Нарита Брайан. I suppose this is
one of her
training spots.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Excuse me. May I have a word?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I didn't mean to take you by
surprise. I'm Бива Хаяхидэ,
Нарита Брайан's
sister.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I've heard stories about your many
stubborn attempts to speak with
her. So
when I saw you here, I had to come talk to
you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to be nervous. I'd just like
a few minutes of your time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Phew. Time for a cooldown. Would you write down my latest time with the blue pen?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I'm helping Biwa
Hayahide with her training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. This will make excellent data.
That wind sprint you
suggested was
effective as well. I'm always looking for
ways to
improve.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you kept me company
until this late hour, meaning
you put your
trainees first... Yes, I think you'll do well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Shall we move on to the main topic of
discussion?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. I wanted to test you.
According to my hypothesis, one's
attitude
toward training also expresses who they
are as a person.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm well aware of my discourtesy, but I
simply had to know for
sure—whether or
not I can place my hopes in you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I would like to ask that you accompany
Нарита Брайан to my debut race.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You see, I heard a concerning rumor
making the rounds. If it's true, I
want her
to see a real race...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Before she leaves the academy for good.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
